Warn this many days before expiry

spec.help: How often to activate, reset, warn and expire. Lower means more load on every Outline server.
spec.label: Scheduler interval (seconds)

spec.help: 0 disables caching entirely — every dashboard poll then hits the experimental metrics endpoint of every server.
spec.label: Metrics cache (seconds)

spec.help: How often the panel samples every server for the live view. One sampler serves every open tab, so this is the real load on your Outline servers regardless of how many people are watching.
spec.label: Live update interval (seconds)

spec.help: A comment is sent this often so a proxy does not close an idle stream. Lower it if your reverse proxy times out sooner.
spec.label: Live update keep-alive (seconds)

spec.help: How often VPN clients are told to re-fetch the subscription.
spec.label: Subscription refresh (hours)

spec.help: How long a login stays valid.
spec.label: Session lifetime (seconds)

spec.help: Attempts allowed from one address inside the window below.
spec.label: Failed logins per IP

spec.help: Ceiling across every address, so rotating IPs can't walk past the per-IP limit.
spec.label: Failed logins in total

spec.help: Consecutive, not total — one missed check is a blip, and alerting on blips teaches people to ignore the alert.
spec.label: Alert after this many failed checks

spec.help: Snapshots are taken with VACUUM INTO, which does not interrupt the panel. Turn the whole thing off with Backups enabled.
spec.label: Automatic backup every (hours)

spec.help: Older snapshots are deleted once this many newer ones exist.
spec.label: Backups to keep

spec.help: How many customers a bulk server change works on in parallel. Higher finishes sooner and asks more of the destination server at once; 1 is the old one-after-another behaviour.
spec.label: Bulk operations at once

spec.help: The subscription link is public and each fetch reaches every server, so a client on a tight refresh loop multiplies load. 0 disables caching.
spec.label: Subscription page cache (seconds)

spec.help: Anything above this is refused with 429.
spec.label: Subscription fetches per minute, per address

spec.help: Older entries are deleted by the scheduler. The log only grows, so this is what stops it.
